title: Absolve, quesumus, domine (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez (doubtful attribution), Absolve, quesumus, domine. 6 voices (Superius, Altus 2, Altus 1, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2601); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
